shots.name: group
shots.prompt: A lively, good-looking group of Nigerian neighbours of different ages chat and laugh together on a quiet street inside a gated Lagos estate, two of them glancing at their phones. Duplexes, palms and a water tank behind. Warm late-afternoon light, hands relaxed.

shots.name: notice
shots.prompt: An elegant Nigerian man in his sixties in a crisp kaftan sits on the shaded veranda of his duplex in a gated Abuja estate, reading a message on his phone with an interested, approving expression. Potted plants and palms behind. Soft morning light. Phone held loosely in one hand, screen facing away from camera.
